objective: Complete all previously listed P0/P1 browser capabilities through the task-owned built-in browser

requirements.acceptance: User cancelled deletion; preserve application-owned iframe previews and all unrelated code
User restored iframe support: nested same-origin and cross-origin frame enumeration, observation, trusted input and stale frame rejection
Open shadow roots observation and input with exact node identity, without claiming closed-root support
Accessible names, scoped exact locators, native roles and state, with useful AX observation
Bounded URL/text/value/state/count/response conditions and business result assertions separate from dispatched input
Single/multiple upload and completed actual download/export artifact with contents verified
Alert/confirm/prompt/beforeunload handled without deadlocking the caller, tied to the correct task tab
Virtualized, paginated and infinite data reading with row identity, horizontal scrolling and explicit completeness evidence
Double/right/modifier click, drag, sequential text, dates and editor interactions; cancellation releases held input
Task-owned open/list/select/close/back/forward/reload without taking another task's page
Bounded request/response/console/error events, action association and reviewable traces
Browser-local screenshot coordinate actions bound to tab/document/viewport/zoom provenance and stale rejection
Human login/2FA handoff resumes the exact pending tab and verifies its state without replaying business effects

invariants: Fixed task tab and document identity
No replay of uncertain side effects
acceptanceScope: Current source on Windows/Electron 44.5.1, isolated local fixtures and actual registered tool chain; no authenticated-site, Linux desktop, whole-repository or release acceptance
